title: Alibaba partners with Apple to integrate Qwen AI model into Apple Intelligence for Chinese market
summary: Alibaba partners with Apple to integrate Qwen AI into Apple Intelligence for China
detailed: Alibaba's feature enters iOS developer beta on Nov.

4, ahead of its December iOS 27.3 launch
Chinese tech company Alibaba Group has partnered with Apple to integrate its Qwen AI model into Apple Intelligence for the Chinese market, state-run Xinhua news agency reported Saturday.
Alibaba CEO Eddie Wu said the partnership would bring new AI-powered services to Chinese users.

Wang Xiaojie, an AI expert at Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications, said this marked the first time a major global consumer hardware maker had adopted a Chinese large language model as its primary system-level AI backbone in the Chinese market.

4, ahead of its December iOS 27.3 launch
Chinese tech company Alibaba Group has partnered with Apple to integrate its Qwen AI model into Apple Intelligence for the Chinese market, state-run Xinhua news agency reported Saturday.
The feature will be available for testing in the latest iOS developer beta starting Nov.
4 and will launch with the official iOS 27.3 release in December, Alibaba said.
Qwen’s AI capabilities will be integrated into several Apple features, including Siri, Writing Tools and Visual Intelligence.
